headline: Amicus deal lifts revenue, dents GAAP profit
summary_short: BioMarin's Q2 2026 revenue rose 20% y/y (29% q/q) to $989.7M on the addition of GALAFOLD and POMBILITI + OPFOLDA from the Amicus acquisition, while GAAP net income fell 81% to $44.8M ($0.23 diluted EPS) on acquisition-related and financing costs; management raised full-year revenue, VOXZOGO, and non-GAAP EPS guidance.
summary_long: Total revenue grew 20% y/y (29% q/q) to $990M on GALAFOLD and POMBILITI + OPFOLDA (acquired from Amicus, April 27 2026), new VOXZOGO patients, and US PALYNZIQ growth, partly offset by lower VIMIZIM (order timing) and ALDURAZYME (Sanofi fulfillment timing). GAAP operating income fell to $111M (11.2% margin vs 33.5%) on $84M acquisition-related costs, $73M intangible amortization (up from $5M), and higher SG&A; interest expense rose to $63M on Amicus financing. GAAP net income fell 81% y/y to $45M ($0.23 diluted EPS); non-GAAP income was $236M ($1.20 diluted EPS). Cash fell to $874M after the $5,068M Amicus acquisition, offset by $3,650M in new borrowings. FY2026 guidance raised: revenue to $3,875-3,925M, VOXZOGO to at least $1,000M, non-GAAP diluted EPS to $4.90-5.10.
